card.name: Small words in preparation and use instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as per, each, of, in after a noun or verb in instructions for preparing, storing or using a product. Also appears in some company and product names like Tetra Pak.

modes.label: Instruction linking words
modes.description: Words like per or each right before a manufacturer, table, or use reference in preparation and storage directions.
modes.example: To Administer Attach administration set<< per>> manufacturer’s instructions.

modes.label: Packaging company names
modes.description: Partway through carton or packaging company names, or the word in after a building-products company.

card.writes: Weakly suggests design- and product-related words (designs, designers) next, with no clear link to the contexts.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in how-to-prepare or how-to-store directions, and on some packaging company names.
